status: PREREGISTERED (committed before any held-out 2025-26 evaluation of the challenger or the 2025-26 champion audit was run)
authority: RESEARCH_ONLY. No promotion, no production wiring, no wagering change regardless of the verdict.

hypotheses.H1_skaters: WORKLOAD_V1 (repaired deployment-share workload x opponent-adjusted team PP/SH/EV/OT minutes, league-relative shrunk shot rates x opponent shots-against factor x venue, NegBin) forecasts 2025-26 regular-season skater shots on goal better than the production PLAYER_SIM_V1 expected_sog.
hypotheses.H2_goalies: WORKLOAD_V1 (schedule-adjusted opponent SF x own SA, short memory, explicit OT shots, pull mixture, shrunk goalie save fraction, Binomial | NegBin) forecasts 2025-26 regular-season starter saves better than the production PLAYER_SIM_V1 saves simulation.

held_out_definition: 2025-26 regular season (game_type 2): every dressed skater-game with a production champion row (official boxscore SOG target, OT shots included); every starting goalie (official saves; CONDITIONAL_ON_ACTUAL_STARTER, no point-in-time starter source exists historically).

chronology.dispersion_fit_season: the season immediately before the evaluated season (2024-25 for the held-out run), each arm on its own residuals
chronology.point_in_time: every player / team / goalie feature for a game on date D uses rows dated strictly before D

skaters.BASELINE: Poisson(EW SOG per game, half-life 10 games, 5 pseudo-games of the position mean)
skaters.CHAMPION: production PLAYER_SIM_V1 expected_sog (players.roster.build_roster, production team-minute template), Poisson (production emits only a mean)
skaters.CHAMPION_NB: same mean, NegBin with alpha fit on the previous season (isolates the distribution shape)
skaters.WORKLOAD_ONLY: WORKLOAD_V1 minutes x CHAMPION rates (ev/pp/sh), NegBin
skaters.EFFICIENCY_ONLY: CHAMPION minutes x WORKLOAD_V1 rates and opponent/venue factor, NegBin

goalies.BASELINE: Poisson(own EW shots against x league save fraction)
goalies.CHAMPION: production PLAYER_SIM_V1 saves draws (nhl-sim-2.0 + simulate_players + simulate_saves, walk-forward)
goalies.WORKLOAD_ONLY: WORKLOAD_V1 shots-against x CHAMPION implied save fraction
goalies.EFFICIENCY_ONLY: CHAMPION expected shots faced x WORKLOAD_V1 goalie save fraction

selection.criterion: lowest mean CRPS of WORKLOAD_V1 on the validation season

distribution: PIT coverage of central 50% and 80% intervals (exact for discrete forecasts)
metrics.uncertainty: game-clustered percentile bootstrap, 2000 resamples of games, seed 20261012, 95% CI of challenger minus reference
metrics.secondary_workload: TOI MAE (total, PP, SH, EV incl OT) champion vs WORKLOAD_V1; shots-faced squared error champion vs WORKLOAD_V1
metrics.secondary_efficiency: SOG given ACTUAL minutes (each arm's own rates); saves given ACTUAL shots faced (each arm's save fraction)

skaters_all_required: ladder Brier(WORKLOAD_V1) - ladder Brier(CHAMPION_NB): 95% CI upper < 0
CRPS no worse than CHAMPION_NB for forwards AND for defencemen (point estimates)
goalies_all_required: ladder Brier(WORKLOAD_V1) - ladder Brier(CHAMPION): 95% CI upper < 0
acceptance.verdicts: ACCEPTED only if every check passes for that target; otherwise REJECTED. Acceptance would mean 'eligible for a prospective shadow test', never promotion.

disclosures: The 2024-25 champion decomposition (development audit) was examined before the challenger was designed; 2024-25 is the validation season, not the held-out season.

Validation-season behaviour: skater WORKLOAD_V1 bias was +0.047 shots (close to the 0.05 limit) and goalie 80% coverage 0.771 (at the edge of the band); the thresholds were set from first principles and are NOT relaxed.
The goalie grid optimum hl_sa = 15 sits at the edge of the grid; not extended.

2025-26 has been used as a held-out season by earlier PLAYER_SIM_V1 research (goals / assists / points / saves ladders); none of that work tuned anything on it, and this preregistration does not use it before the evaluation.

The production saves contract settles conditional on the named goalie entering; scoring here is conditional on the actual starter, and the goalie save-fraction term uses the actual starter's identity (labelled CONDITIONAL_ON_ACTUAL_STARTER).
Production PP-minute scaling uses DATA_ONLY_V2 component goals that are not stored historically; the champion's p_pp is the PLAYER_SIM_V1 walk-forward stand-in (team_pp_shares).
The team_states data-quality check (OT timelines of 4800 s, skater on-ice ratios) was run on the raw tables of every season including 2025-26; no forecast was scored on 2025-26.
